You are the Investigator. You ran a query to test a hypothesis (or the change check). Read the rows
in the INPUT and record what they show.

- `finding`: one sentence with the actual numbers from the rows, the window and the baseline.
- `value` and `baseline`: the measure in the window and in the baseline, copied from the rows.
- `effect`: value / baseline - 1 when both exist, otherwise empty.
- `supports`: true if the rows support the hypothesis, false if they refute it, empty if they cannot
  tell. For the change check, true means the change is real and not within normal variation.

Report only what the rows show. Do not add numbers that are not in the rows.

_state":"SP","share_change":-0.0557,"window_aov":110.522,"window_share":0.0372},{"aov_change":28.3132,"baseline_aov":98.485,"baseline_share":0.0143,"category":"perfumery","customer_state":"SP","share_change":-0.0106,"window_aov":126.798,"window_share":0.0037},{"aov_change":33.6783,"baseline_aov":73.34,"baseline_share":0.0071,"category":"garden_tools","customer_state":"MG","share_change":-0.0031,"window_aov":107.018,"window_share":0.0041},{"aov_change":34.6248,"baseline_aov":72.9417,"baseline_share":0.0429,"category":"health_beauty","customer_state":"SP","share_change":0.0001,"window_aov":107.567,"window_share":0.0429},{"aov_change":35.2959,"baseline_aov":135.425,"baseline_share":0.0143,"category":"watches_gifts","customer_state":"RJ","share_change":-0.0065,"window_aov":170.721,"window_share":0.0078},{"aov_change":37.336,"baseline_aov":71.77,"baseline_share":0.0071,"category":"auto","customer_state":"SP","share_change":0.0115,"window_aov":109.106,"window_share":0.0186},{"aov_change":39.36,"baseline_aov":97.94,"baseline_share":0.0071,"category":"fashion_bags_accessories","customer_state":"RJ","share_change":-0.0058,"window_aov":137.3,"window_share":0.0014},{"aov_change":40.32,"baseline_aov":72.56,"baseline_share":0.0071,"category":"telephony","customer_state":"DF","share_change":-0.0061,"window_aov":112.88,"window_share":0.001}],"rows_returned":40,"sql":"WITH order_payments AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment
  FROM payments.order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
order_categories AS (
  SELECT order_id, category
  FROM (
    SELECT oi.order_id,
           pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.order_id ORDER BY oi.price DESC) AS rn
    FROM orders.order_items oi
    JOIN orders.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN orders.product_category_name_translation pct
      ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
order_segments AS (
  SELECT o.order_id,
         CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-08-01' THEN 'window' ELSE 'baseline' END AS period,
         COALESCE(oc.category, 'uncategorized') AS category,
         COALESCE(cs.customer_state, 'unknown') AS customer_state,
         COALESCE(op.order_payment, 0) AS order_payment
  FROM orders.orders o
  LEFT JOIN order_categories oc ON oc.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN orders.customers cs ON cs.customer_id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-09-01'
),
segment_agg AS (
  SELECT category, customer_state, period,
         COUNT(*) AS orders,
         AVG(order_payment) AS aov
  FROM order_segments
  GROUP BY category, customer_state, period
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'window' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS window_n,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'baseline' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS baseline_n
  FROM order_segments
)
SELECT
  s.category,
  s.customer_state,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.period = 'window' THEN s.orders END)::DOUBLE / t.window_n, 4) AS window_share,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.period = 'baseline' THEN s.orders END)::DOUBLE / t.baseline_n, 4) AS baseline_share,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.period = 'window' THEN s.aov END), 4) AS window_aov,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.period = 'baseline' THEN s.aov END), 4) AS baseline_aov,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.period = 'window' THEN s.aov END) - AVG(CASE WHEN s.period = 'baseline' THEN s.aov END), 4) AS aov_change,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.period = 'window' THEN s.orders END)::DOUBLE / t.window_n
      - SUM(CASE WHEN s.period = 'baseline' THEN s.orders END)::DOUBLE / t.baseline_n, 4) AS share_change
FROM segment_agg s
CROSS JOIN totals t
GROUP BY s.category, s.customer_state, t.window_n, t.baseline_n
ORDER BY aov_change ASC
LIMIT 40;","task":{"family":"mix_shift","id":"H3","kind":"hypothesis","statement":"The order mix shifted toward lower-value segments (cheaper product categories or lower-spending customer states) whose share of orders grew since August 2017.","test":{"description":"Compare each segment's share of orders and its average order value, by product category and customer state, in August 2017 versus July 2017 to see whether the decline is concentrated in growing low-value segments.","sources":["orders.orders","orders.order_items","orders.products","orders.product_category_name_translation","orders.customers","payments.order_payments"]}},"truncated":false}
